reviews.text:
Hamburger specialty chain
Located a 1-minute walk from Exit 1 of Sinchon Station.
The tiger beef double set has a discount price of 7,000 won.

Discount price~
This is a hamburger restaurant with a striking Korean interior.
Recently, this place frequently holds 1+1 or discount events.
Try the most common double burger among the various menus~
The concept is a handmade burger, but the visuals are McDonald's?
I can't believe the handmade burger patty looks so oily!
Both the taste and appearance are almost similar to a Big Mac.
Of course, for those who like Big Macs like me~
It contains more vegetables than a Big Mac, so the health balance seems to have improved slightly.
And it seemed to have a special sauce, but it tasted a bit like apple jam and wasn't overly bitter, so it wasn't bad.
I probably wouldn't have been able to eat it all if it was covered in that sauce.
The set includes fries and a canned drink.
If you eat fries with ketchup, you can cover them to some extent~
However, it is disappointing compared to McDonald's gamfries.
The drink is a can of Pepsi, so it's my style!

Store & Tips & Review
The store is not small and consists of the first and second floors.
There is a window on the first floor, and a table and restroom on the second floor.
For a quick meal alone, a window seat on the first floor is good.
Order and pay using the kiosk.
After that, you call the number and they pick you up.
The bright lighting and clean-looking interior are the plus points~
This seems to be the main branch, and there are a few more stores in Jongno.
It feels like the current discount price will remain for quite some time.
It's a pretty good place for people who like Big Macs.
However, if you go there expecting a handmade burger restaurant, you will be disappointed.

Taco Loco.

A taco restaurant in Sinchon.
The characteristic feature of the taco is that it contains a lot of lettuce.
It's made of taco soft shell, and I didn't feel anything special about the shell itself.
I ordered 3 pieces each of chicken, fish, and beef.
The most basic chicken taco has good seasoning. It’s an intuitive taste.
Fish tacos contain fried fish with cod meat. It reminds me of the fish cutlet I used to eat at school lunch. Since it is fried right away, it is very hot, so be careful of burns. The taste itself is good, but since it's fried, it's inevitable that you'll get bitten.
The beef taco tasted like a sour seasoning like sriracha. Personally, I didn't like it among the three.
It can't be said to be a traditional taco, but it had a good texture because it had a lot of lettuce. (Of course, a little bit of cilantro was added as well.) As you eat it, the lettuce spills all over the place. The taco itself is good to eat. It's delicious.
I tried a Mexican drink called Haritos. It has a strong high-fructose corn syrup taste.

There is one long table and about 4 individual tables.
After you go to the ordering counter and order your food, they bring it to you.
Napkins, utensils, and water are self-service.
There is a restroom to the right of the ordering counter.

Intention to revisit) Average

April 11, 2023
07:35PM visit

I visited without really thinking.

General hotteok
Mugwort hotteok
Cream Cheese Hotteok
Ordered black sesame powder.

The interior is really simple; it's half kitchen and half hall.
The hall is small with only a few tables.

Black sesame powder came out first.

I just cry...

Please be sure to visit..

After searching, the menu seems to be changing little by little.
I remember that savory taste again...ㅠ

reviews.author: Kyung Min Kim
reviews.text: I haven't met a single person who said they didn't like the food they ate here. Rice-flavored ice cream with chewy chewy rice is the most delicious. Other than that, salt ice cream and grapefruit ice cream are delicious. The menu changes slightly depending on the season. Anyway, go ahead and eat it. It's clean and not stuffy at all, so it's the best for refreshing your mouth!

reviews.author: Jeongsori
reviews.text:
I don't know why there aren't many reviews about this place, but it's really delicious. The price is reasonable, the owner is friendly, and most of all, the taste is the best, so I went there every day when I was there. It was so delicious.
I've been to all the different gelato places for Icheon rice, but this one is the best. It has a strong milk flavor, but the rice has a good texture, which is another fun thing to do. The green tea flavor is also good because it's steamy and smooth, and the bilberry is refreshing and everything is delicious.
It's obvious that they put a lot of care into making it. It may be difficult to find because it's located in a corner, but if you're near Ewha University, be sure to go there. It's delicious.

reviews.author: Supreme Walnut
reviews.text: Rice and mint flavored ice cream is delicious! I think rice has a truly unique taste! The fragrant taste of rice is excellent! And I don't really like the mint flavor. However, unlike the Baskin Robbins mint flavor, the mint flavor here has a less milky mint flavor! Do you know what it feels like? Haha. It has a slightly clean mint taste, so it’s not greasy and delicious!! Be sure to try it!

reviews.author: KT L
reviews.text:
The best gelato restaurant in Sinchon Ewha Womans University area. From the perspective of someone who filled out two coupons, this place really shouldn't go bankrupt (there's no way it's going bankrupt because business is doing well haha)

Rice really has an overwhelming taste!  There was a time when the two of us ate a 10,000 won Styrofoam packaging filled with nothing but rice. Sweet, milk-based ones like rice, interstellar, black sesame, injeolmi, and jokkoreto, and refreshing ones like sorbet, like green grapes, peach and tomato, are both great.

What's disappointing is that they removed the cups with 3 flavors. Ugh.
